facts.activity_file: preventing water ingress to hot material

assets.label: package boilers and deaerator
assets.service: process steam generation and feedwater deaeration

control_failures.control_label: insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of B-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on B-8201 and PT-8201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating hot and steam systems, specifically preventing water ingress to hot material. B-8201 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 15 January 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on B-8201 and PT-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during cleaning and preparation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
